frozen_findings: Sequential one-record optimizer steps caused strong QA-family and stance-class interference.
The v1 stance head saw a LayerNorm-normalized 4096-D K token and did not receive an explicit absolute K magnitude path.
Matched answer preference contrasted only maintain versus conservative answers and did not separate the other QA families.
Observed adapter output has no independent driving-stance truth and must not be hard-labelled maintain.

architecture.stage1_adapter: frozen task-agnostic spatial observation uncertainty U
architecture.stage2_l_role: ORION/VLM learns task relevance R, task risk K = U * sigmoid(R), interpretable QA semantics and a predicted planning stance

matched_training_unit.records: one event/keyframe counterfactual group: 5 variants x 4 QA families = 20 records
matched_training_unit.cross_family_answer_preference: For each supervised anchor, the target answer must outrank all three same-frame, same-variant answers from the other QA families.
matched_training_unit.question_routing: The question/prompt family is an explicit fixed input prefix; target answer text and target stance never enter forward conditioning.

label_boundary.observed: No hard driving-stance CE and no hard driving-implication language target; use only spatial/epistemic consistency, R-map supervision and held-out consequence calibration.
label_boundary.view_shuffled_uq: Diagnostic negative-control only for driving stance; no hard stance CE and no hard driving-implication language target.
label_boundary.caution_status: Vocabulary is retained but is not considered calibrated by this pilot unless an independently consequence-grounded intermediate-risk label is added in a later frozen protocol.
label_boundary.rationale: Do not turn generated adapter scores or a constructed shuffled-view expectation into independent driving truth.

offline_audit_gate: All new and regression tensor-contract tests pass in the pinned ORION environment.
A dataset dry run proves exactly one optimizer boundary per complete 20-record matched group.
Observed and view-shuffled driving answers are absent from hard language and stance losses.
Raw K max/mean/rms have a finite nonzero gradient path to stance logits.
Zero-U output remains invariant to R.
The frozen 8-event 6/2 bank and all selected geometry packages are hash-bound.
unlock_policy: Passing offline audit only makes v6 implementation reviewable. A separate immutable amendment and explicit user authorization are required for one held-out 8-event pilot; Route196 must not be rerun.
claim_boundary: Prepared architecture and loss contracts only; no new learning, generalization, planning, closed-loop or safety evidence.
